instructions: Read the supplied reef commentary or game instructions exactly once. Use a warm, calm, clear conversational adult voice for a parent and child exploring together. Quiet wonder, gentle natural expression, comfortable conversational pace. Do not add words, greetings, music, sound effects or character voices. Do not whisper. Say the E key as the letter E. Pronounce gramma as GRAM-uh, Anomalops as uh-NOM-uh-lops, and katoptron as kuh-TOP-tron.
qualityScope: Full OGG decode, level measurement and independent speech transcription. No human listening approval has been performed.
